import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
for n in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    gi=G[n+' input']; go=G[n+' output']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0]); A,B=len(go),len(go[0])
    tw=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if gi[r][c]==2]
    arm=[(r,c) for r in range(A) for c in range(B) if go[r][c]==2]
    ps=sorted({c-r for r in range(A) for c in range(B) if go[r][c]==1})
    bs=sorted(set(c-r for r,c in tw))
    print('===',n,'arm:',arm[:6],'seed offsets:',bs,'painted:',ps)

            d=c-r
            if d!=s and (d-s)%4==0 and d<s:
                out[r][c]=1
    return out

def f(g):
    B=len(g[0]); s=g[0].index(2)
    # arm 2s: V wedge centered at (0,s)
    tset={(r,c) for r in range(B) for c in [s-r,s+r] if 0<=c<B}
    out=[[0]*B for _ in range(B)]

        if dd>=s: continue
        if (dd-s)%4!=0: continue

        if start is None: continue
        for r in range(start,B):
            out[r][r+dd]=1
    return out

import json, os, re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def f(g):
    W=len(g[0]); s=g[0].index(2)
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(W)]
    for dd in range(-W,W):
        if dd>=s or (dd-s)%4!=0: continue
        twos=[r for r in range(W) if r+dd>=0 and r<W and 0<=r+dd<W and (r,r+dd) in {(r,c) for r in range(W) for c in [s-r,s+r] if 0<=c<W} ]
        starts=[r for r in twos]
        start = (max(starts)+1) if starts else None
        start = (start or next((r for r in range(W) if r+dd>=0 and r<W and 0<=r+dd<W), None))
        if start is None: continue
        for r in range(start,W):
            cc=r+dd
            if 0<=cc<W: out[r][cc]=1
    return out

for n in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    print(n, f(G[n+' input'])==G[n+' output'])
res=f(G['Test input']); print(json.dumps(res))
